title: Print Uniform Block Spacing
description: Fix inconsistent vertical spacing between chapters, sections, paragraphs, windows, and other block elements in print LaTeX. All inter-block gaps must use exactly one spacing unit (semio@spacing@single).
summary: Windows now get one block-spacing unit before they open when following body text, matching paragraph line gaps. Added semio_block_sep_before/after with a semio@block@sep@done flag so headings and consecutive windows do not double-space. Applied to typed window kinds and generic Window environment. paper.pdf builds successfully.
